description: POST /api/v1/users accepts 'role' field in request body, allowing any authenticated user to create users with arbitrary roles including ADMIN
POST /api/v1/customers and PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id accept 'role' field, allowing BARBER/CUSTOMER to set arbitrary roles
POST /api/v1/barbers and PATCH /api/v1/barbers/:id accept 'active' field, allowing mass assignment of active status
POST /api/v1/services and PATCH /api/v1/services/:id accept 'active' field, allowing mass assignment of active status
GET /api/v1/users and GET /api/v1/users/:id expose passwordHash field in response
GET /api/v1/customers/:id and PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id do not verify ownership - CUSTOMER can access other customers' data
GET /api/v1/appointments/:id and PATCH /api/v1/appointments/:id/status do not verify ownership - Customer can access other customers' appointments
GET /api/v1/barbers/:id does not verify ownership - Barber can access other barbers' data
Customer can access appointment of another customer via GET /appointments/:id
GET /api/v1/transactions allows CUSTOMER and BARBER to access admin-only endpoint
GET /api/v1/users allows CUSTOMER and BARBER to access admin-only endpoint
POST /api/v1/barbers allows BARBER to access admin-only endpoint
POST /api/v1/services allows BARBER to access admin-only endpoint
POST /api/v1/users allows CUSTOMER and BARBER to create users with arbitrary roles
findByCustomerId, findByBarberId, findByStatus, findByCustomerIdAndStatus, findByDateRange use string concatenation instead of parameterized queries
Error handler exposes stack traces, internal error details, and stack traces in 500, 404, and validation error responses
vulnerableRequireRole middleware allows CUSTOMER to access endpoints requiring ADMIN if allowedRoles includes CUSTOMER
Auth middleware does not validate if token is revoked or if account is inactive
